question: Who is the author of the book 'Love Is Always Right and Other Musings'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinita Dawra Nangia**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• **Vinita Dawra Nangia** is the author of the book **"Love Is Always Right and Other Musings"**, a collection of writings exploring life, love, relationships, and human emotions. 

• She is known for her work as a **journalist, columnist, and writer** with deep insights into human behavior and societal issues. 

• The book includes a compilation of her columns published in leading newspapers, reflecting her thoughts and musings on various aspects of life. 

• Vinita Dawra Nangia is associated with publications like **The Times of India**, where she has contributed extensively to lifestyle and relationship columns.
